correct.zh: 在图 1 的甘特图中，把「当初计划」和「变更计划」两条横条对比着看，变更计划采取的措施共有 3 项。(1) B 公司的软件开发（外部采购管理）的结束时间从 9 月中旬提前到 8 月末，也就是缩短了 0.5 个月。(2) 验收测试·验收从 9 月中旬～10 月中旬移到了 9 月初～9 月末。期间仍是 1 个月，开始和结束一起提前了 0.5 个月。(3) 流通计划·促销业务从 9 月中旬～10 月末移到了 8 月中旬～9 月末。这里 1.5 个月的期间同样没有变化，只是开始时间提前，其结果是 8 月中旬～8 月末这 0.5 个月与仍在进行的 B 公司的软件开发并行推进。只有这 3 项同时具备，项目最后工序（验收测试·验收和流通计划·促销业务）的结束才会从 10 月末变为 9 月末，整体正好实现缩短 1 个月。要点在于：只把开发缩短 0.5 个月，排在后面的流通计划·促销业务不动，整体就不会缩短；反过来只把流通计划·促销业务提前，能够并行的余地也只有 0.5 个月。把「缩短 0.5 个月」和「并行 0.5 个月」相加凑成 1 个月的这种组合，只有 イ 描述正确，所以正解是 イ。
correct.en: In the Gantt chart of Figure 1, comparing the two bars labeled original plan and modified plan shows that the modified plan takes three measures. (1) Company B's software development (external procurement management) now finishes at the end of August instead of mid-September, that is, it is shortened by 0.5 months. (2) The acceptance testing and acceptance inspection moves from mid-September to mid-October to early September to the end of September. Its duration stays at one month, and both its start and its end are moved up by 0.5 months. (3) The distribution planning and promotion work moves from mid-September to the end of October to mid-August to the end of September. Here too the duration stays at 1.5 months and only the start is moved up, so that the 0.5 months from mid-August to the end of August now runs in parallel with Company B's software development, which is still under way. Only when all three are in place does the end of the project's final activities (the acceptance testing and acceptance inspection, and the distribution planning and promotion work) move from the end of October to the end of September, achieving exactly one month of shortening overall. The key point is this: shortening the development by 0.5 months alone leaves the distribution planning and promotion work at the back untouched, so the whole schedule does not shrink; conversely, moving up only the distribution planning and promotion work gives just 0.5 months of room for parallel work. Only イ correctly describes the combination of 0.5 months of shortening plus 0.5 months of parallel work adding up to one month, so the answer is イ.

distractors.zh: 措施不够。把开发缩短 0.5 个月、把验收测试·验收提前 0.5 个月之后，软件的取得一侧确实会在 9 月末结束（当初是 10 月中旬）。但是流通计划·促销业务仍按当初计划留在 9 月中旬～10 月末，所以项目的结束日期依然是 10 月末。也就是说整体缩短量为 0 个月，并不是「能缩短 0.5 个月」。能够提前的只有软件取得一侧的工序，既然没有对留到最后的工序动手，项目工期就一天也缩短不了。
distractors.en: The measures are insufficient. If the development is shortened by 0.5 months and the acceptance testing and acceptance inspection is moved up by 0.5 months, the software acquisition side does indeed finish at the end of September (originally mid-October). However, the distribution planning and promotion work remains as in the original plan, from mid-September to the end of October, so the project's finish date stays at the end of October. In other words the overall shortening is zero months; it is not even a case of gaining 0.5 months. Only the activities on the software acquisition side were moved up, and as long as nothing is done about the activity that finishes last, the project duration does not shrink by even a single day.

distractors.zh: 该选项说的是把开发一口气缩短 1 个月，但首先，图 1 的变更计划中实际缩短的是 0.5 个月（结束时间从 9 月中旬提前到 8 月末），并不是 1 个月。而且即使真的能缩短 1 个月，后续的流通计划·促销业务仍按当初计划留到 10 月末结束，因此整体同样不会缩短 1 个月。只想着削减 B 公司的工作，本公司一侧的市场营销工序就会作为瓶颈残留下来。
distractors.en: This option says the development is shortened by a full month at once, but first of all, what is actually shortened in the modified plan of Figure 1 is 0.5 months (the finish moves from mid-September to the end of August), not one month. Moreover, even if one month could be cut, the subsequent distribution planning and promotion work would remain as in the original plan, ending at the end of October, so the whole schedule still would not be shortened by one month. Cutting only Company B's work leaves the company's own marketing activity behind as the bottleneck.

distractors.zh: 并行作业的量与图 1 不符。在图 1 的变更计划中，B 公司的软件开发在 8 月末结束，流通计划·促销业务在 8 月中旬开始，因此重叠的部分是 0.5 个月，并行 1 个月是不成立的。此外该选项完全没有提到开发缩短 0.5 个月；如果不缩短开发而只把流通计划·促销业务提前，验收测试·验收仍会按当初计划持续到 10 月中旬，整体也就无法缩短 1 个月。
distractors.en: The amount of parallel work does not match Figure 1. In the modified plan of Figure 1, Company B's software development ends at the end of August and the distribution planning and promotion work starts in mid-August, so the overlap is 0.5 months; one month of parallel work is not possible. In addition, this option says nothing about shortening the development by 0.5 months, and if the distribution planning and promotion work is merely moved up without shortening the development, the acceptance testing and acceptance inspection still runs to mid-October as originally planned, so the overall schedule is not shortened by one month.

points.zh: 甘特图是把各项作业以横条形式排列在时间轴上的进度管理图。把当初计划、变更计划和实际业绩并排画出来，就能区分开读出每项作业缩短了多少（条变短）和提前了多少（条向左移动）。整体工期由「最后结束的那项作业的结束时点」决定。
points.en: A Gantt chart is a progress management chart that lays out activities as horizontal bars along a time axis. Drawing the original plan, the modified plan, and the actual results side by side lets you tell apart how much each activity was shortened (the bar gets shorter) and how much it was moved up (the bar slides to the left). The overall duration is determined by the finish time of the activity that ends last.

points.zh: 缩短工期有两种典型手法：通过增加人员等方式压缩作业本身所需期间的方法（赶工，crashing），以及把本应依次进行的作业部分重叠推进的并行作业（快速跟进，fast tracking）。本题把开发缩短 0.5 个月（前者）与后续工序并行 0.5 个月（后者）组合起来，挤出合计 1 个月；关键在于——如果不对最后结束的工序动手，整体就不会缩短。
points.en: There are two typical techniques for shortening a schedule: reducing the duration of the work itself by, for example, adding staff (crashing), and overlapping part of work that would normally be done in sequence, that is, parallel work (fast tracking). This question combines shortening the development by 0.5 months (the former) with overlapping the following activity by 0.5 months (the latter) to produce one month in total, and the key point is that the overall schedule does not shrink unless you do something about the activity that finishes last.
